marks.name: A default stack needs no backup control
marks.why: Managed stack, Agora's keys: the backup is Agora's job. One sentence in the cost card says so; the separate Backup providers section is gone.

marks.name: Header frozen at all times
marks.why: Name, status, id and the actions stay under the app bar while the page scrolls; the rail, section headers and test rail now stick under it.

marks.name: Backup recap under each model
marks.why: One line names the backup and whose key it runs on. It is read-only here; it and the gear open the same Configure sheet, where the backup is set.

marks.name: Same line, every model
marks.why: STT, LLM and TTS carry the same recap. No inline select, no second section.

name: after6-sheet-backup
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Configure models manually'));if(b&&b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700));document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Configure STT vendor and credential"]')?.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900));document.querySelector('#wz-backup-asr')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});})()

marks.name: Backup lives in the model's own sheet
marks.why: Vendor, credential, model, then Backup: the order things are needed in. The primary is listed but disabled, ineligible vendors say why, No backup is a choice.

marks.name: The backup has its own key
marks.why: Same credential control as the primary. A backup in Agora's pool runs on Agora Managed Key; any other vendor asks for one of your saved credentials right here.

name: after6-sheet-backup-byo
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Configure models manually'));if(b&&b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='false')b.click();await wait(700);document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Configure STT vendor and credential"]')?.click();await wait(900);const t=document.querySelector('#wz-backup-asr');t.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,button:0,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));await wait(500);const opt=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].find(o=>o.textContent.startsWith('Google STT v2'));if(opt){opt.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));opt.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{bubbles:true,button:0,pointerType:'mouse',pointerId:1}));}await wait(600);document.querySelector('#wz-bcred-asr-pick')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});})()

marks.name: No key, no backup
marks.why: Google STT is bring-your-own-key: the switch locks on and the select offers your saved credentials, No credential selected and Create credential. Until a key is picked the recap says needs your Google key.

marks.name: One table, frozen header
marks.why: Voice, Traits, Voice ID, Compare stay put while the list scrolls, and never highlight.

marks.name: Recommended is a badge, not a second list
marks.why: The three recommended voices sort to the top of the same rows with a star badge; same columns, same Compare, same Use voice.

marks.name: One door to the voice dialog
marks.why: The field opens Select voice. The extra Browse voices button did the same thing and is gone; the TTS sheet's Voice field is the same control.

marks.name: Empty state on the section grid
marks.why: The same row as Knowledge base and MCP server: copy on the left, the door on the right. The centered block that broke the grid is gone.
